matrix.short_title: The Moral Machine experiment
matrix.authors: Edmond Awad; Sohan Dsouza; Richard Kim; Jonathan Schulz; Joseph Henrich; Azim Shariff; Jean-François Bonnefon; Iyad Rahwan
matrix.A2_rationale: The original Moral Machine experiment. Not grounded in a specific moral psychology theory but creates a novel empirical paradigm for studying moral preferences in trolley-type dilemmas at global scale.
matrix.A6_rationale: 40 million decisions from 2.3M+ people in 233 countries. Published in Nature. Demonstrates universal and culturally variable preferences. The gold standard for trolley-type moral preferences.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 40 million decisions from 2.3M+ people across 233 countries in 10 languages. 9 moral dimensions measured.

matrix.file: 2024-Takemoto-The moral machine experiment on large language.md
matrix.short_title: The moral machine experiment on large language
matrix.authors: Kazuhiro Takemoto
matrix.A2_rationale: Applies the Moral Machine methodology to LLMs with 50,000 generated scenarios across 6 moral dimensions. Theory-derived from established experimental paradigm.
matrix.A6_rationale: Uses established Moral Machine methodology with published human baselines from 40M+ decisions. Published in Royal Society Open Science. Conjoint analysis framework.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 50,000 generated moral machine scenarios across 6 primary dimensions (species, social value, gender, age, fitness, utilitarianism) + 3 secondary dimensions

matrix.short_title: Crowdsourcing moral machines
matrix.authors: Edmond Awad; Sohan Dsouza; Jean-François Bonnefon; Azim Shariff; Iyad Rahwan
matrix.A2_rationale: Overview/perspective paper on the Moral Machine platform. Describes methodology and discusses implications. Same underlying paradigm as the Nature paper.
matrix.A6_rationale: CACM overview of the validated Moral Machine platform. Discusses methodological critiques and responses. Published in Communications of the ACM.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Describes the same 40M-decision Moral Machine platform from the Nature paper

matrix.short_title: Language Model Alignment in Multilingual Trolley
matrix.authors: Zhijing Jin; Max Kleiman-Weiner; Giorgio Piatti; Sydney Levine; Jiarui Liu; Fernando Gonzalez; Francesco Ortu; András Strausz; Mrinmaya Sachan; Rada Mihalcea; Yejin Choi; Bernhard Schölkopf
matrix.A2_rationale: Builds on the validated Moral Machine experiment methodology with parametric variation across 6 moral dimensions (species, gender, fitness, status, age, number). Theory-derived from moral psychology literature.
matrix.A6_rationale: Leverages 40M+ human judgments from Moral Machine as baseline. Systematic parametric variation. Published at ICLR 2025. Cross-lingual analysis with 107 languages.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 1,000 trolley-problem vignettes translated into 107 languages, derived from Moral Machine parametric framework across 6 moral dimensions
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: GPT-3, GPT-4, GPT-4o mini, Llama-2, Llama-3, Gemma-2, Mistral, Phi-3, Qwen-2

matrix.short_title: Moral Foundations Twitter Corpus
matrix.authors: Joe Hoover; Gwenyth Portillo-Wightman; Leigh Yeh; Shreya Havaldar; Aida Mostafazadeh Davani; Ying Lin; Brendan Kennedy; Mohammad Atari; Zahra Kamel; Madelyn Mendlen; Gabriela Moreno; Christina Park; Tingyee E. Chang; Jenna Chin; Christian Leong; Jun Yen Leung; Arineh Mirinjian; Morteza Dehghani
matrix.A2_rationale: The foundational MFT annotated corpus. 35k tweets annotated for 10 moral sentiment categories (5 foundations x virtue/vice). Theory-derived annotation scheme with trained annotators.
matrix.A6_rationale: 35,108 tweets, 13 trained annotators with psychological/demographic metadata. Baseline classification results. Seminal dataset that spawned many follow-up works. Published in SPPS.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 35,108 tweets from 7 domains (BLM, ALM, Baltimore protests, 2016 election, hate speech, Hurricane Sandy, MeToo) annotated for 10 moral sentiment categories

matrix.file: 2025-Zaim Bin Ahmad-Large-scale moral machine experiment on large.md
matrix.short_title: Large-scale moral machine experiment on large
matrix.authors: Muhammad Shahrul Zaim Bin Ahmad; Kazuhiro Takemoto
matrix.A2_rationale: Scales the Moral Machine methodology to 52 LLMs using conjoint analysis framework. Theory-derived from established experimental paradigm with systematic model comparison.
matrix.A6_rationale: Conjoint analysis with published human baselines. 52 LLMs tested including multiple versions and sizes. Published in PLOS ONE. Systematic analysis of model size and update effects.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 50,000 moral machine scenarios per model, evaluated on 52 LLMs. 6 primary moral dimensions + 3 secondary dimensions.
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o, o1, Claude-3, Gemini, Gemma, Llama-3, Vicuna, Mistral, Command-R, Phi-3

matrix.file: 2022-Fraser-Does Moral Code Have a Moral Code.md
matrix.short_title: Does Moral Code Have a Moral Code?
matrix.authors: Kathleen C. Fraser; Kiritchenko, Svetlana; Balkir, Esma
matrix.A2_rationale: Probes Delphi model with MFQ/Schweder's Big Three Ethics + deontology/utilitarianism measures. Adapts validated instruments to Delphi's input/output format.
matrix.A4_source_instrument: MFQ + Schweder's Big Three + Oxford Utilitarianism Scale (adapted)
matrix.A6_rationale: Uses established instruments adapted for Delphi's three-class output format. Compares to published demographic patterns. Limited by Delphi's constrained output space.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Adapted versions of MFQ, Schweder's ethics measure, and Oxford Utilitarianism Scale, plus sacrificial dilemmas. Exact item count not specified.
matrix.D5_source_publication: MFQ + Schweder's Big Three + Oxford Utilitarianism Scale (adapted)

matrix.file: 2024-Khandelwal-Do Moral Judgment and Reasoning Capability of.md
matrix.short_title: Do Moral Judgment and Reasoning Capability of
matrix.authors: Aditi Khandelwal; Utkarsh Agarwal; Kumar Tanmay; Monojit Choudhury
matrix.publication: Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics
matrix.A2_rationale: Extends DIT administration to 6 languages, directly using Kohlberg's CMD framework with standard DIT scoring (P-score, Personal Interest, Maintaining Norms).
matrix.A6_rationale: Uses validated DIT instrument. Compares against published human norms. Novel contribution is multilingual translation but no new psychometric validation of translations.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Same 9 dilemmas as Tanmay et al. 2023 translated into 6 languages, each with 12 ethical considerations

matrix.short_title: Moral Foundations Vignettes
matrix.authors: Scott Clifford; Vijeth Iyengar; Raúl Cabeza; Walter Sinnott-Armstrong
matrix.A2_rationale: Original development and validation of Moral Foundations Vignettes (MFVs) -- 132 standardized scenarios each violating a specific moral foundation. Extensive validation with EFA, CFA, and correspondence with MFQ.
matrix.A6_rationale: Multi-study validation: Study 1 validates classification accuracy and controls for scenario complexity; Study 2 demonstrates correspondence with MFQ and conducts EFA + CFA. Gold-standard stimulus set.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 132 one-sentence vignettes across 5 moral foundations (Care physical/emotional, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, Sanctity) + social norm violations

matrix.file: 2022-Bago-Situational factors shape moral judgments in the.md
matrix.short_title: Situational factors shape moral judgments in the trolley dilemma
matrix.A2_rationale: Adapts Greene et al.'s trolley dilemma paradigm (intent + personal force manipulation) for cross-cultural replication. Well-established experimental paradigm but adapted for massive multi-country deployment rather than using a standardized survey instrument.
matrix.A6_rationale: Gold-standard cross-cultural replication of Greene et al. with 27,502 participants from 45 countries. Preregistered, rigorous exclusion criteria, multiple robustness checks. Distinguishes Eastern/Southern/Western cultural clusters. Published in Nature Human Behaviour.

matrix.short_title: Moral Foundations of Large Language Models
matrix.authors: Marwa Abdulhai; Gregory Serapio-García; Clement Crepy; Daria Valter; John Canny; Natasha Jaques
matrix.A2_rationale: Directly administers the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30), a validated instrument from MFT, with standard scoring across 5 foundations.
matrix.A6_rationale: MFQ-30 is extensively validated. Paper compares LLM scores to published human population data across political affiliations and societies. Includes consistency analysis and downstream behavioral task.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 30-item MFQ plus consistency probes across multiple conversational contexts, plus downstream donation benchmark

matrix.short_title: Differences in Moral Foundations of LLMs
matrix.authors: Peter Kirgis
matrix.A2_rationale: Directly administers the Moral Foundations Vignettes (MFV; Clifford et al. 2015) -- 116 moral vignettes on a Likert scale -- to 20+ frontier LLMs. Compares to nationally representative human sample.
matrix.A6_rationale: Uses validated MFV instrument with published nationally representative US human baseline from Clifford et al. Descriptive statistical analysis including PCA of moral foundations.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 116 moral vignettes from Clifford et al. 2015, rated on 0-4 severity scale by 20+ LLMs from 6 providers
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude-3 Opus, DeepSeek, GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o, Gemini, Grok, Llama-3, o3-mini

matrix.file: 2024-Hadar-Shoval-Assessing the Alignment of Large Language Models With Human Values.md
matrix.short_title: Assessing the Alignment of LLMs With Human Values (PVQ-RR)
matrix.A2_rationale: Directly administers the PVQ-RR (Portrait Values Questionnaire - Revised), the gold-standard validated Schwartz instrument. 10 trials per LLM for reliability assessment. Comprehensive comparison with published norms from 53,472 individuals across 49 nations.
matrix.A6_rationale: Uses the PVQ-RR with published reliability and validity data. Benchmarks against 53,472 humans across 49 nations. Discriminant analysis differentiates 4 LLMs. Mental health dilemma validation further confirms construct validity. Gold-standard psychometric approach.

matrix.file: 2023-Deng-Probing the Moral Development of Large Language.md
matrix.short_title: Probing the Moral Development of Large Language
matrix.authors: Kumar Tanmay; Aditi Khandelwal; Utkarsh Agarwal; Monojit Choudhury
matrix.A2_rationale: Directly administers the Defining Issues Test (DIT), a validated psychometric instrument for Kohlberg's CMD model, with standard scoring (P-score, Personal Interest, Maintaining Norms).
matrix.A6_rationale: DIT has 30+ years of validation with 400+ studies across 40+ countries. The paper uses standard DIT scoring and compares against published human norms (adult, college, graduate student ranges).
matrix.B2_size_notes: 5 standard DIT dilemmas + 4 newly designed dilemmas, each with 12 ethical considerations to rate and rank
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: ChatGPT, GPT-3, GPT-3.5, GPT-4, Llama-2, PaLM

matrix.short_title: Whose Morality Do They Speak?
matrix.authors: Meltem Aksoy
matrix.A2_rationale: Administers the updated MFQ-2 (Atari et al. 2023) across 8 languages to 4 LLMs. Uses validated instrument with published cross-cultural human baselines.
matrix.A6_rationale: MFQ-2 validated across 25 populations. Compares LLM responses to human responses from Atari et al. 2023 in the same languages. Addresses WEIRD bias limitation of MFQ-1.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 36 MFQ-2 items (6 per foundation) administered in 8 languages to 4 LLMs, measuring 6 foundations (care, equality, proportionality, loyalty, authority, purity)

matrix.file: 2024-Vida-Decoding Multilingual Moral Preferences - Unveiling LLM's Biases.md
matrix.short_title: Decoding Multilingual Moral Preferences -- Unveiling LLM's Biases Through the Moral Machine Experiment
matrix.authors: Karina Vida; F. Damken; A & Lauscher
matrix.A2_rationale: Extends Moral Machine Experiment to multilingual LLM evaluation across 10 languages. Theory-inspired but focuses on preference bias detection rather than theory operationalization.
matrix.A6_rationale: Compares to published Moral Machine human data. Systematic multilingual analysis. Published at AIES 2024.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 6,500 Moral Machine scenarios in 10 languages, administered to 5 LLMs

matrix.short_title: The Dutch Moral Foundations Stimulus Database
matrix.authors: Franziska Hopp
matrix.A2_rationale: Rigorous cross-cultural adaptation and validation of MFV and SMID (Socio-Moral Image Database) for Dutch populations. Multi-study validation following original procedures.
matrix.A6_rationale: 586 crowd-workers, 38,460+ individual judgments. Full validation following original MFV/SMID procedures. Demonstrates cross-cultural transferability of MFT stimuli to European populations.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 120 translated MFV vignettes + 120 SMID images, each rated on moral and affective dimensions by Dutch crowd-workers

matrix.short_title: Value Kaleidoscope
matrix.authors: Sorensen, Taylor; Jiang, Liwei; Hwang, Jena; Levine, Sydney; Pyatkin, Valentina; West, Peter; Dziri, Nouha; Lu, Ximing; Rao, Kavel; Bhagavatula, Chandra; Sap, Maarten; Tasioulas, John; Choi, Yejin
matrix.A2_rationale: Value pluralism framework inspired by philosophical value pluralism, not a specific moral psychology theory. GPT-4 generates values, rights, and duties for 31k situations.
matrix.A6_rationale: 218k values from GPT-4, rated 91% high-quality by annotators. Large-scale human study with diverse demographics. Transfers to other philosophical frameworks. Published at AAAI 2024.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 218k contextualized values/rights/duties connected to 31k human-written situations. Model generates, explains, and assesses relevance/valence of values.

matrix.short_title: Multilingual Defining Issues Test
matrix.authors: Aditi Khandelwal; Utkarsh Agarwal; Kumar Tanmay; Monojit Choudhury
matrix.A2_rationale: Same paper as #3 (Khandelwal-Do Moral Judgment). Published version at EACL 2024. Identical DIT administration across 6 languages.
matrix.A6_rationale: Same as entry #3. This is the published EACL version of the same work.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Duplicate of entry #3
matrix.override_reason: DIT is a published validated instrument (Rest 1979); scenarios reproducible from paper (EACL 2024)

matrix.short_title: The Moral Foundations Reddit Corpus
matrix.authors: Jackson Trager; Alireza S. Ziabari; Elnaz Rahmati; Aida Mostafazadeh Davani; Preni Golazizian; Farzan Karimi-Malekabadi; Ali Omrani; Zhihe Li; Brendan Kennedy; Nils Karl Reimer; Melissa Reyes; Kelsey Cheng; Mellow Wei; Christina Merrifield; Arta Khosravi; Evans Alvarez; Morteza Dehghani
matrix.A2_rationale: Large-scale annotated corpus using updated MFT framework (8 categories including Equality/Proportionality split). Expert-annotated for moral sentiment.
matrix.A6_rationale: 16,123 comments annotated by 3+ trained annotators. Uses updated MFT framework (Atari et al. 2023). Baselines with BERT, Llama, Ministral. Published at LREC-COLING.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 16,123 Reddit comments from 12 subreddits, annotated for 8 moral categories (Care, Proportionality, Equality, Purity, Authority, Loyalty, Thin Morality, Implicit/Explicit)

matrix.short_title: Social Chemistry 101
matrix.authors: Maxwell Forbes; Jena D. Hwang; Vered Shwartz; Maarten Sap; Yejin Choi
matrix.A2_rationale: Crowdsourced rules-of-thumb annotated with 12 dimensions including moral foundations (as one dimension). MFT is referenced but social norms are broader than moral psychology.
matrix.A6_rationale: 292k rules-of-thumb with 4.5M annotations across 12 dimensions. Large-scale crowdsourced effort. Published at EMNLP 2020. Widely adopted in downstream work.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 292k rules-of-thumb from 104k situations, each annotated on 12 dimensions (social judgment, moral foundations, cultural pressure, legality, etc.)

matrix.file: 2026-Huang-Knowing But Not Doing Convergent Morality and Divergent Action in.md
matrix.short_title: Knowing But Not Doing: Convergent Morality and Divergent Action in LLMs (ValAct-15k)
matrix.A2_rationale: Directly uses PVQ-40 (validated Schwartz instrument) alongside VALACT-15K scenario-based benchmark grounded in Schwartz's 10 basic values. Dual-method design (questionnaire + scenario) enables knowledge-action gap analysis.
matrix.A6_rationale: PVQ-40 is a well-validated instrument. VALACT-15K systematically covers 10 Schwartz values across 5 domains. Human participants (n=55) provide baseline. Knowledge-action gap analysis is methodologically sophisticated. Cross-cultural comparison (US vs Chinese LLMs).

matrix.file: 2024-Nunes-Conscience Conflict Evaluating Language Models' Moral Understanding.md
matrix.short_title: Conscience Conflict: Evaluating Language Models' Moral Understanding
matrix.authors: José Luiz Nunes; Guilherme F. C. F. Almeida; Marcelo de Araujo; Simone D. J. Barbosa
matrix.A2_rationale: Administers both MFQ (abstract values) and MFV (concrete violations) to test consistency between professed values and moral judgments -- a novel hypocrisy detection methodology grounded in MFT.
matrix.A6_rationale: Uses two validated instruments in tandem. Compares within-instrument consistency (high for both) against cross-instrument consistency (low), revealing hypocrisy. Rigorous methodology.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 30 MFQ items + ~120 MFV scenarios, measuring 6 moral foundations including Liberty

matrix.short_title: Building Interpretable Models for Moral Decision-Making
matrix.authors: M. Goel; A Das
matrix.A2_rationale: Builds custom transformer trained on Moral Machine data. Theory-inspired architecture (character type, cardinality, team) but does not operationalize specific moral psychology theory.
matrix.A6_rationale: Trained on 3M+ Moral Machine scenarios. 77% validation accuracy. Interpretability experiments (causal intervention, layer attribution, circuit probing). Published as preprint.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 3M scenarios from Moral Machine survey data (5.4M total, 1.7M unique). Custom 2-layer transformer with 104K parameters.

matrix.file: 2026-Tagarelli-Culturally Grounded Personas in Large Language Models.md
matrix.short_title: Culturally Grounded Personas in Large Language Models: Characterization and Alignment with Socio-Psychological Value Frameworks
matrix.authors: Andrea Tagarelli
matrix.A2_rationale: Administers MFQ-2 (36 items, 6 foundations) to culturally-conditioned LLM personas. Uses validated instrument in a novel persona-generation framework grounded in WVS and Inglehart-Welzel map.
matrix.A6_rationale: Uses MFQ-2 (Atari et al. 2023, validated across 25 populations). Compares to WVS data and Inglehart-Welzel cultural map. Comprehensive cross-cultural framework.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 93,312 unique cultural configurations, each generating a persona profile, with 36 MFQ-2 items per persona + WVS indicators

matrix.short_title: MFTCXplain
matrix.authors: Jackson Trager; Francielle Vargas; Diego Alves; Matteo Guida; Mikel K. Ngueajio; Ameeta Agrawal; Yalda Daryani; Farzan Karimi-Malekabadi; Flor Miriam Plaza-del-Arco
matrix.publication: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
matrix.A2_rationale: Expert-annotated multilingual dataset using MFT categories for hate speech moral reasoning. Theory-derived annotation schema but applied to hate speech rather than standard moral vignettes.
matrix.A6_rationale: Expert-annotated by native speakers with diverse backgrounds. Uses established MFT annotation scheme from MFTC/MFRC tradition. Inter-annotator agreement reported.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 3,000 tweets in 4 languages annotated for hate speech, moral categories (MFT), and text-span rationales via multi-hop explanation

matrix.short_title: Insights into Moral Reasoning of AI
matrix.A2_rationale: Directly uses two validated instruments: Moral Competence Test (MCT, Lind's Kohlberg-based) and Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ, Haidt/Graham). Both are well-established, standardized tools administered to LLMs and humans.
matrix.A6_rationale: MCT and MFQ are extensively validated instruments. Human sample of 53 students with power analysis. Comparative design (humans vs 3 LLMs). However, sample is limited to Indian higher education students, and LLM sample uses default chat interfaces rather than API.

matrix.short_title: Are Rules Meant to be Broken? (UniMoral)
matrix.A2_rationale: Constructs UniMoral with psychologically grounded moral dilemmas annotated with MFT-aligned ethical principles, Kohlberg-inspired typology classification, and Hofstede cultural profiles. Integrates multiple frameworks into a unified pipeline rather than using single validated instruments.
matrix.A6_rationale: Multi-framework integration (MFT, Kohlberg, Hofstede). 6 languages with crowd-sourced annotations including moral and cultural profiles. Four targeted tasks (action prediction, moral typology, factor attribution, consequence generation). Comprehensive cross-linguistic evaluation.

matrix.short_title: Assessing LLMs for Moral Value Pluralism
matrix.authors: Noam Benkler; Drisana Mosaphir; Scott Friedman; Andrew Smart; Sonja Schmer-Galunder
matrix.A2_rationale: Uses WVS-derived moral value statements with Recognizing Value Resonance (RVR) model to measure implicit moral values in LLM text. Theory-derived from Inglehart-Welzel cultural map dimensions.
matrix.A6_rationale: Uses established WVS with published norms across 100+ nations and 40+ years. RVR model is novel NLP approach. Validated against WVS demographics. Published at NeurIPS 2023.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 5 open-ended questions (about God, children, abortion, national pride, authority) + 1 general value prompt, probing 5 WVS traditional-secular values

matrix.file: 2016-Xu-How Can a Deontological Decision Lead to Moral.md
matrix.short_title: How Can a Deontological Decision Lead to Moral
matrix.authors: Xu, Zhi Xing; Ma, Hing Keung
matrix.A2_rationale: Uses validated instruments: Aquino & Reed's moral identity scale (internalization/symbolization), Brady & Wheeler's ethical predisposition measure, and behavioral tasks. Multi-study design.
matrix.A4_source_instrument: Moral Identity Scale (Aquino & Reed 2002) + Ethical Predisposition Measure
matrix.A6_rationale: Two-study design: Study 1 (web survey), Study 2 (experimental). Uses validated scales with established reliability. Factor analysis. Moderation analysis. Published in J Business Ethics.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Study 1: ~180 participants (web survey); Study 2: ~70 participants (experiment with dictator game variant)
matrix.D5_source_publication: Moral Identity Scale (Aquino & Reed 2002) + Ethical Predisposition Measure

matrix.file: 2025-Shen-ValueCompass A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment.md
matrix.short_title: ValueCompass: A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment
matrix.A2_rationale: Adapts SVS and PVQ into scenario-based Value Form instrument. Uses Schwartz's 56 values across 10 types but contextualizes them into 4 real-world scenarios. Robust prompting with 8 variants per question. Not a direct administration of standard instruments.
matrix.A6_rationale: Grounded in Schwartz's 56 values with SVS/PVQ-derived items. 112 humans from 7 countries across 4 scenarios. Multiple alignment metrics (rate, distance, ranking). Cross-country and cross-scenario analysis. Robust 8-variant prompting reduces noise.

matrix.short_title: M$^3$oralBench
matrix.authors: Bei Yan; Jie Zhang; Zhiyuan Chen; Shiguang Shan; Xilin Chen
matrix.A2_rationale: Built on Moral Foundations Vignettes (MFVs) expanded with GPT-4o generation. Evaluates 6 moral foundations from MFT. Theory-derived items but generated rather than validated.
matrix.A6_rationale: Adapted from validated MFV instrument. Expanded to 1,160 scenarios via GPT-4o. Image generation adds multimodal dimension but without separate psychometric validation of expanded set.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 1,160 moral violation scenarios across 6 moral foundations, each with corresponding image, evaluated on 3 tasks (judgment, classification, response)
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: GPT-4o, Gemini, InternLM, Llama-2, Phi-3, Qwen, Yi

matrix.short_title: How Much of a Pluralist is ChatGPT?
matrix.A2_rationale: Uses the Magic Wand Survey (MWS), a validated instrument measuring two dimensions of pluralism (Both/and Reasoning and Willingness to Preserve Difference). Direct administration to chatbots with systematic 120-iteration design.
matrix.A6_rationale: Well-grounded in value pluralism theory (Berlin, MFT). Two validated dimensions with human comparison sample N=335. Systematic cross-model comparison. However, MWS is not a mainstream moral psychology instrument.

matrix.file: 2025-Sachdeva-Normative Evaluation of LLMs with Everyday Moral Dilemmas.md
matrix.short_title: Normative Evaluation of LLMs with Everyday Moral Dilemmas
matrix.A2_rationale: Theory-inspired approach using MFT themes (Fairness, Harm, etc.) via Yudkin et al.'s AITA moral framework. Not a direct MFT instrument adaptation; rather uses naturalistic moral dilemmas classified by moral themes. No validated instrument administered.
matrix.A6_rationale: Leverages Yudkin et al.'s validated 6-theme moral framework applied to AITA. 10,826 dilemmas with 476K human comments provide strong ecological validity. Cross-model comparison across 7 LLMs. However, moral reasoning themes are emergent, not theory-driven.

matrix.short_title: CVC
matrix.authors: Wu, Ping; Shen, Guobin; Zhao, Dongcheng; Wang, Yuwei; Dong, Yiting; Shi, Yu; Lu, Enmeng; Zhao, Feifei; Zeng, Yi
matrix.A2_rationale: Novel Chinese value framework based on core socialist values (3 dimensions, 12 core values, 50 derived values). References MFT but deliberately rejects it as Western-centric.
matrix.A4_source_instrument: None (novel Chinese value framework, adapted from Social Chemistry 101 and MIC)
matrix.A6_rationale: 250k value rules with human annotation. 87.5% alignment with Chinese annotators. Validated against 17 LLMs. Novel framework grounded in Chinese political/cultural context.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 250k+ value rules, 400k+ rule-based moral dilemma scenarios. 10,998 evaluated across 17 LLMs.
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, GPT-4o, Llama-3, Qwen
matrix.D5_source_publication: None (novel Chinese value framework, adapted from Social Chemistry 101 and MIC)

matrix.file: 2025-Zhu-TrolleyBench - Evaluating Emergent Moral Reasoning and Consistency in.md
matrix.short_title: TrolleyBench -- Evaluating Emergent Moral Reasoning and Consistency in LLMs
matrix.authors: Andrew Zhu
matrix.A2_rationale: Theory-inspired benchmark drawing on Kohlberg, Schwartz, and MFT literature. Focuses on consistency metrics (ECI, entropy-based Inconsistency Score) rather than theory operationalization.
matrix.A6_rationale: Novel consistency metrics (ECI, Inconsistency Score) are interesting but not validated. Human baselines collected but limited. No convergent/discriminant validity.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Approximately 50 dilemmas with clarifying and contradictory follow-ups, designed for consistency evaluation

matrix.short_title: Tracing Moral Foundations in LLMs
matrix.authors: Yu, Chenxiao; Yi, Bowen; Karimi-Malekabadi, Farzan; Abdurahman, Suhaib; Ye, Jinyi; Narayanan, Shrikanth; Zhao, Yue; Dehghani, Morteza
matrix.A2_rationale: Uses MFT as analytic framework for mechanistic interpretability study. Probes internal representations using MFV-derived stimuli but focuses on representation analysis, not behavioral measurement.
matrix.A6_rationale: Demonstrates representational alignment between LLM internal states and human moral judgments. SAE feature analysis and causal steering provide mechanistic evidence. Novel but different from behavioral validation.
matrix.B2_size_notes: MFT concept stimuli for probing + vignettes for activation analysis. Focus is on internal representations, not behavioral outputs.

matrix.short_title: Model Editing as a Double-Edged Sword
matrix.authors: Baixiang Huang; Zhen Tan; Haoran Wang; Zijie Liu; Dawei Li; Ali Payani; Huan Liu; Tianlong Chen; Kai Shu
matrix.A2_rationale: BEHAVIORBENCH is grounded in Rest's Four Component Model, Kohlberg's stages, MFT, and normative ethics. Three-tier structure maps to moral psychology theory progression.
matrix.A4_source_instrument: Social Chemistry 101, MoralChoice, ETHICS, Jiminy Cricket (composite)
matrix.A6_rationale: Three-tier theoretical grounding (moral sensitivity, judgment, agency). Uses established datasets. Tests behavior editing across frontier LLMs. Novel paradigm but composite benchmark.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Composite from Social Chemistry 101, Low/High-Ambiguity MoralChoice, ETHICS, Jiminy Cricket datasets across 3 tiers
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, GPT-4o, Gemini, Grok, Llama-2, Llama-3, Mistral, Qwen, o1, o3
matrix.D5_source_publication: Social Chemistry 101, MoralChoice, ETHICS, Jiminy Cricket (composite)

matrix.short_title: PRIME Framework Convergent Ethics
matrix.authors: W. Russell Neuman; Coleman, Chad; Shah, Manan
matrix.A2_rationale: Introduces the PRIME framework combining consequentialist-deontological analysis, MFT, and Kohlberg's stages. Theory-derived but novel analytic methodology rather than validated instrument.
matrix.A6_rationale: Novel framework grounded in three established theories. Includes confidence metrics and consistency analysis but no psychometric validation of the framework itself.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Classic moral dilemmas (Trolley, Heinz, etc.) + direct questioning protocol administered to 6 LLMs
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude, Gemini, GPT-4o, LLaMA, Llama-3, Mistral

matrix.short_title: Mapping Moral Reasoning Circuits
matrix.authors: Sigurd Schacht; Carsten Lanquillon
matrix.A2_rationale: Mechanistic interpretability study using 240 validated moral/immoral statement pairs based on MFT's 6 dimensions. Theory-derived stimuli for neuron-level analysis.
matrix.A6_rationale: 240 curated statement pairs. Differential activation analysis + ablation experiments. Identifies specialized neurons for moral dimensions. Novel but no behavioral validation.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 240 validated moral/immoral statement pairs across 6 MFT dimensions (care, fairness, loyalty, authority, sanctity, liberty)

matrix.short_title: MoralBench
matrix.authors: Ji, Jianchao; Chen, Yutong; Jin, Mingyu; Xu, Wujiang; Hua, Wenyue; Zhang, Yongfeng
matrix.A2_rationale: Uses both MFQ-30 and Moral Foundations Vignettes as two datasets in a two-stage evaluation pipeline. Theory-derived from MFT but with novel ranking methodology.
matrix.A6_rationale: Adapted from two validated instruments (MFQ, MFV). Novel two-stage framework comparing moral identity across instruments. Compares to published human data.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 30 MFQ items + 132 MFV scenarios, split into stages for rank-based moral identity evaluation

matrix.file: 2025-Wu-The Staircase of Ethics Multi-step Moral Dilemmas.md
matrix.short_title: The Staircase of Ethics (Multi-step Moral Dilemmas)
matrix.A2_rationale: Constructs 3,302 five-stage moral dilemmas grounded in both MFT and Schwartz Theory. Actions are mapped to value dimensions via structured LLM assessment with three-tier validation. Instrument is adapted from theoretical frameworks, not a direct survey instrument.
matrix.A6_rationale: Dual theoretical grounding (MFT + Schwartz). Three-tier validation (parallel assessment, majority agreement, expert review). Dynamic multi-step design captures temporal value shifts. However, no human baseline and validation relies on LLM consensus rather than psychometric testing.

matrix.short_title: The Moral Foundations Weibo Corpus
matrix.authors: Cao, Renjie; Hu, Miaoyan; Wei, Jiahan; Ihnaini, Baha
matrix.A2_rationale: Annotated Chinese social media corpus using MFT's 10 moral categories (5 foundations x virtue/vice). Theory-derived annotation scheme but applied to naturalistic text rather than experimental stimuli.
matrix.A6_rationale: Manual annotation by 3+ trained annotators with kappa reliability testing. LLM baseline experiments for moral sentiment classification. Follows MFTC/MFRC tradition.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 25,671 Chinese Weibo comments across 6 topics, annotated for 10 MFT moral categories

matrix.short_title: From Stability to Inconsistency
matrix.authors: Monika Jotautaite; Mary Phuong; Chatrik Singh Mangat; Maria Angelica Martinez
matrix.A2_rationale: Theory-derived dataset of 1,079 moral dilemmas grounded in all 6 MFT foundations (including Liberty). Each dilemma has 6 options corresponding to each foundation. Generated by GPT-4o with expert input.
matrix.A6_rationale: GPT-4o-generated scenarios validated with 92% human annotation agreement. Multi-preference evaluation methodology (single, pair, triple, total) is novel. But no convergent/discriminant validity.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 1,079 real-world moral dilemmas, each with 6 options mapping to 6 moral foundations, evaluated via 4 preference methods (single/pair/triple/total)
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude-2, Claude-3, GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o, Gemini, Llama-3

matrix.short_title: The Pluralistic Moral Gap
matrix.A2_rationale: Theory-inspired: constructs a 60-value taxonomy from 3,783 value expressions extracted from rationales. Novel value taxonomy but not grounded in a specific validated moral psychology instrument. Distributional alignment approach is original.
matrix.A6_rationale: 60-value taxonomy derived empirically from human rationales provides ecological validity. Distributional alignment (not just majority) is methodologically strong. Dynamic Moral Profiling shows 64.3% improvement. However, taxonomy is not externally validated.

matrix.file: 2025-Jiang-EMNLP Educator-role Moral and Normative LLMs Profiling.md
matrix.short_title: EMNLP (Educator-role Moral and Normative LLMs Profiling)
matrix.A2_rationale: Extends existing personality scales (HEXACO, OUS/GGB) and constructs 88 teacher-specific moral dilemmas grounded in Kohlberg's stages. Uses adapted instruments rather than validated originals directly, but substantial instrument development work.
matrix.A6_rationale: Compares LLM personality profiles with human teachers but construct validity for the 88 dilemmas is not formally validated with psychometric analysis. Kohlberg staging is conceptual rather than rigorously operationalized with DIT-2 or similar.

matrix.short_title: Revisiting the Trolley Problem for AI
matrix.authors: Sahan Hatemo; Christof Weickhardt; Luca Gisler; Oliver Bendel
matrix.A2_rationale: Uses trolley problem variants (switch, loop, footbridge) with demographic variations inspired by Moral Machine, but does not operationalize a specific validated instrument.
matrix.A6_rationale: Compares LLM responses to Moral Machine human survey data, but no psychometric testing of the adapted instrument. Demographic variations are novel but not validated.
matrix.B2_size_notes: 852 unique demographic combinations across 3 trolley problem variants, tested in multiple languages

matrix.file: 2025-Neuman-Analyzing the Ethical Logic of Six Large Language Models.md
matrix.short_title: Analyzing the Ethical Logic of Six Large Language Models
matrix.authors: W. Russell Neuman; Chad Coleman; Manan Shah
matrix.A2_rationale: Uses three ethical typologies (consequentialist-deontological, MFT, Kohlberg) as analytic frameworks for coding LLM explanations, but does not administer standardized instruments.
matrix.A6_rationale: No psychometric testing. Qualitative analysis of LLM responses to moral dilemmas (Trolley, Heinz) coded against theoretical frameworks. No systematic scoring or validation.
matrix.B2_size_notes: A battery of classic moral dilemmas (Trolley, Heinz, etc.) administered to 6 LLMs with follow-up explanation prompts
matrix.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude, Gemini, GPT-4o, LLaMA, Llama-3, Mistral

matrix.short_title: Value-Spectrum
matrix.A2_rationale: Designs VQA benchmark around Schwartz's 10 value dimensions using social media video content. Adapted instrument: constructs visual questionnaires aligned to Schwartz dimensions but not using the standard PVQ/SVS directly.
matrix.A6_rationale: Maps to Schwartz dimensions conceptually, but no formal psychometric validation. VQA format for VLMs is novel but untested as a value measurement tool. No human comparison sample for value assessment.

matrix.file: 2025-Duan-AdAEM Adaptively and Automated Extensible Measurement for Value.md
matrix.short_title: AdAEM: Adaptively and Automated Extensible Measurement for Value Alignment
matrix.A2_rationale: Grounded in Schwartz Value Theory but auto-generates adaptive questions via information-theoretic optimization. Not a direct SVT instrument; rather a dynamic, self-extensible framework inspired by SVT structure.
matrix.A6_rationale: Information-theoretic objective (JSD) provides a principled basis for question generation. Extensive analysis across 16 LLMs validates discriminability. However, no human baseline and no formal psychometric validation of generated questions.

matrix.file: 2025-Ye-GPLA Generative Psycho-Lexical Approach for Constructing Value Systems.md
matrix.short_title: GPLA: Generative Psycho-Lexical Approach for Constructing Value Systems
matrix.A2_rationale: Proposes a novel LLM-specific 5-factor value system derived via psycho-lexical approach (GPLA). Benchmarks against Schwartz's values with CFA validation. Instrument-adapted: uses Schwartz as baseline but constructs new system (Social Responsibility, Risk-taking, Rule-following, Self-competence, Rationality).
matrix.A6_rationale: Strong psychometric grounding: CFA for structural validity, LLM safety prediction for predictive validity, alignment benchmarking for representational power. Tested on 33 LLMs with 21 value-anchoring prompts. Novel but rigorous methodology.

matrix.short_title: Concerns and Values in Human-Robot Interactions
matrix.authors: Giulio Antonio Abbo; Tony Belpaeme; Micol Spitale
matrix.A2_rationale: Develops HRI-specific value taxonomy through scoping review and expert focus groups. References Schwartz values and MFT but develops independent value framework for robot design.
matrix.A6_rationale: Expert focus groups validate value taxonomy. Pilot study of web tool. Not a psychometric instrument -- a design tool for HRI researchers.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Design tool with curated value taxonomy, not a dataset. Scoping review covered ~200 HRI papers.

matrix.file: 2024-Zangari-A survey on moral foundation theory and pre-trained language models.md
matrix.short_title: A survey on moral foundation theory and pre-trained language models: current advances and challenges | AI & SOCIETY
matrix.authors: Zangari, Lorenzo; Candida Maria Greco; Picca, Davide; Andrea Tagarelli
matrix.A2_rationale: Survey paper reviewing the intersection of MFT and PLMs. Does not introduce a new instrument or dataset.
matrix.A6_rationale: Review paper. Provides comprehensive taxonomy of MFT+PLM approaches but no original psychometric data.
matrix.B2_size_notes: Survey paper reviewing existing datasets, methods, and findings

matrix.file: 2026-Hu-The Straight and Narrow Do LLMs Possess an Internal Moral Path.md
matrix.short_title: The Straight and Narrow: Do LLMs Possess an Internal Moral Path?
matrix.A2_rationale: Uses MFT's five foundations (Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, Sanctity) to construct moral vectors via linear probing. Adapts MFT concepts for mechanistic interpretability rather than traditional survey instruments. Cross-lingual validation (EN/ZH).
matrix.A6_rationale: Cross-lingual probing validates shared moral representations. Moral vectors are mechanistically grounded in MFT dimensions. However, no formal psychometric validation or human baseline comparison for the probing approach itself.
